mapping_method: Preserve all154 previous mappings except explicit genuine Q18 survival additions; append all9 surviving real-core questions before any expanded answers. Separate unasked key background. Reachability credit remains separate from grading requirements.
grading_scope: Judge all actually requested material facts using equivalent wording and implied actors in context. A fixed key may include explanatory background; key_context_not_required is not an additional answer requirement or tested source coverage. A response need not recite stipulated givens or a counting guard if its answer already respects them.

creator_provenance.role: Pre-test consolidation of both independently accepted map16 context corrections

questions.question: Mists of Oblivion does 1 Damage to each Town/City in its target. Does this automatically destroy healthy buildings? Can Damage boosts count for its destruction-based Fear?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Mists of Oblivion does 1 Damage to each Town/City in its target. Does this automatically destroy healthy buildings? Can Damage boosts count for its destruction-based Fear?
required_facts: One Damage does not automatically destroy healthy Towns or Cities; prior/additional Damage is needed.
Damage boosts belong to the original Power and buildings actually destroyed by that boosted Damage count for its destruction-based Fear.

questions.question: A Power such as Words of Warning makes Dahan deal Ravage Damage earlier than normal. Is that an extra attack in addition to the normal counterattack?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Power such as Words of Warning makes Dahan deal Ravage Damage earlier than normal. Is that an extra attack in addition to the normal counterattack?
required_facts: An early Dahan Ravage attack changes timing rather than adding an extra attack.
Each Dahan still deals Ravage Damage only once.

questions.question: For outcome checks, how are a Fear Card containing only each-player instructions and one containing a global instruction plus each-player instructions divided into actions?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: For outcome checks, how are a Fear Card containing only each-player instructions and one containing a global instruction plus each-player instructions divided into actions?
required_facts: A Fear Card with only each instructions has one action per each.
A card mixing global and each instructions has one overall action with nested per-each actions.
Check outcomes after the appropriate complete action tree, not after combining independent each-player actions into one.

questions.question: An Invader is left illegally in an Ocean after its primary action and all triggered actions finish. Assume it was not Drowned. May it remain there, where is it placed instead, and does that relocation count as movement or trigger movement effects?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: An Invader is left illegally in an Ocean after its primary action and all triggered actions finish. Assume it was not Drowned. May it remain there, where is it placed instead, and does that relocation count as movement or trigger movement effects?
required_facts: An illegally placed Invader cannot remain in Ocean between action trees.
Clean the illegally placed Invader up to the nearest legal land.
That relocation is not movement and triggers no movement effects.

key_context_not_required.fact: If no legal land exists return it to supply.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: No absence of all legal lands is posed; Q81 separately asks that exception.

key_context_not_required.fact: Cleanup occurs before the outcome check after the action tree.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks nearest-legal-land relocation, whether it counts as movement and whether it triggers movement effects. It does not ask its position relative to victory checks or the additional non-movement classifications.

key_context_not_required.fact: Cleanup is also not Remove, Destroy or an action.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks nearest-legal-land relocation, whether it counts as movement and whether it triggers movement effects. It does not ask its position relative to victory checks or the additional non-movement classifications.

questions.question: A Ravage adds Blight that reduces Vital Strength of the Earth’s Sacred Site to one Presence. Does losing the site retroactively remove its Defend from the Damage simultaneously dealt to Dahan in that Ravage?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Ravage adds Blight that reduces Vital Strength of the Earth’s Sacred Site to one Presence. Does losing the site retroactively remove its Defend from the Damage simultaneously dealt to Dahan in that Ravage?
required_facts: Losing Earth's Sacred Site to resulting Blight does not retroactively remove its Defend from that Ravage.
Land and Dahan Damage were simultaneous and both were protected by the existing site's Defend.

questions.question: Can a Spirit give its unused Energy or Card Plays to another Spirit, or save unused Card Plays for the next turn? How does this differ from an explicit Power that grants another Spirit Energy or an extra play?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Can a Spirit give its unused Energy or Card Plays to another Spirit, or save unused Card Plays for the next turn? How does this differ from an explicit Power that grants another Spirit Energy or an extra play?
required_facts: There is no ordinary transfer of individual Energy or Card Plays.
Unused Card Plays cannot be saved for the next turn.
Explicit Powers granting Energy or extra plays follow their instructions and can give those benefits.

key_context_not_required.fact: Unused Energy can carry over to the next turn.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks transfer of Energy/Card Plays, saving Card Plays and explicit grants. It never asks saving Energy.

questions.question: What is the order of the Invader Phase, and if a Blighted Island start-of-phase effect destroys a Spirit’s last Presence, may an earned Fear Card resolve first to avert defeat?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: What is the order of the Invader Phase, and if a Blighted Island start-of-phase effect destroys a Spirit’s last Presence, may an earned Fear Card resolve first to avert defeat?
required_facts: Invader Phase order is Blighted Island instructions, earned Fear, Ravage, Build, Explore, advance cards.
Complete the start-of-phase Blighted effect tree and check outcomes before Fear.
If the Spirit still has no island Presence and there is no simultaneous victory, lose before the earned Fear card can resolve.
Do not reorder Fear ahead of the Blighted instruction to avert defeat.

questions.question: Bringer uses a Power whose explicit instructions include Damage or Destroy Dahan, followed by other legal effects. Are the Dahan harmed, and must the entire Power be skipped?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Bringer uses a Power whose explicit instructions include Damage or Destroy Dahan, followed by other legal effects. Are the Dahan harmed, and must the entire Power be skipped?
required_facts: Bringer's explicit Damage/Destroy instructions do nothing to the Dahan.
Skip those impossible harmful instructions and resolve other legal effects normally; do not forego the entire Power just because of them.

key_context_not_required.fact: Bringer can directly destroy its own Presence.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The asked recipient is Dahan; the own-Presence exception is explanatory context rather than an asked outcome.

questions.question: Does Shadows of the Dahan's Range-ignoring targeting ability extend a numeric Range arrow within a Power's effect text? How does a general Power Range boost differ?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Does Shadows of the Dahan's Range-ignoring targeting ability extend a numeric Range arrow within a Power's effect text? How does a general Power Range boost differ?
required_facts: Shadows' conditional targeting ability affects only the numeric Range for choosing a land target; it does not extend internal Range arrows.
General Power Range bonuses can affect printed Range arrows in both the targeting box and effect text, subject to their restrictions.

key_context_not_required.fact: General boosts do not boost another Range bonus or another Spirit actions merely because targeted.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: These further boundaries are not needed to contrast targeting-only with internal Range arrows; Q119/Q120 request them directly.

key_context_not_required.fact: Neither type of numeric Range modification waives nonnumeric origin or target requirements.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The requested contrast is targeting-only versus internal Range arrows. The separate nonnumeric-requirement waiver question is directly asked in Q28/Q72, not here.

questions.question: A Power's own threshold gives it +1 Range. If the threshold is met on both the original use and its Repeat, does the Repeat get +2 Range? If that threshold is no longer met on the Repeat, is the first +1 retained?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Power's own threshold gives it +1 Range. If the threshold is met on both the original use and its Repeat, does the Repeat get +2 Range? If that threshold is no longer met on the Repeat, is the first +1 retained?
required_facts: Do not apply the same internal +1 Range threshold again on Repeat; it retains +1 rather than becoming +2.
The original Range modification remains even if the threshold's Elements are no longer met.

questions.question: A Spirit plays two Power Cards and later Repeats one. For an effect counting Power Cards played, such as Boon of Vigor, is the count two or three? Does the Repeat consume another ordinary Card Play, and does it nevertheless count as a new Power use?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Spirit plays two Power Cards and later Repeats one. For an effect counting Power Cards played, such as Boon of Vigor, is the count two or three? Does the Repeat consume another ordinary Card Play, and does it nevertheless count as a new Power use?
required_facts: Count two cards played, not three; Repeat does not play another card.
Repeat consumes no extra ordinary Card Play.
It nevertheless counts as a new Power use.

key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: It asks ordinary Card Play consumption and use/card-play counting, not the Repeat permission cost.

questions.question: A Blighted Island instruction simply tells each Spirit to destroy one of its Presence. May a Spirit choose a disk still covering its Presence track to uncover a benefit instead of destroying island Presence, and where does a destroyed disk go?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Blighted Island instruction simply tells each Spirit to destroy one of its Presence. May a Spirit choose a disk still covering its Presence track to uncover a benefit instead of destroying island Presence, and where does a destroyed disk go?
required_facts: An unqualified Presence destruction instruction uses island Presence, not Presence-track disks.
A Spirit cannot choose a track disk to reveal a benefit.
Put the destroyed island disk beside the island, not back on its panel.

questions.question: In standard setup using a Blight Card, how is the card chosen, which side starts face-up, and may players inspect its reverse before choosing or starting?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: In standard setup using a Blight Card, how is the card chosen, which side starts face-up, and may players inspect its reverse before choosing or starting?
required_facts: Choose a random Blight Card.
Start Healthy Island face-up.
Do not inspect its reverse before choosing/starting.

questions.question: A Spirit has met an unused Innate’s Element requirements but has no cards in hand, no Energy and no ordinary Card Plays left. Can it use that Innate at the proper speed, what Energy or Card Play cost does it ordinarily have, and is it automatically available every turn?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Spirit has met an unused Innate’s Element requirements but has no cards in hand, no Energy and no ordinary Card Plays left. Can it use that Innate at the proper speed, what Energy or Card Play cost does it ordinarily have, and is it automatically available every turn?
required_facts: The eligible unused Innate may be used at its proper Speed without cards in hand, Energy or Card Plays.
Unless explicitly specified otherwise, it costs no Energy or Card Play.
Innates are automatically available each turn when their requirements are met.

key_context_not_required.fact: Ordinary once-per-turn and targeting rules still apply.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The premise specifies an unused, eligible Innate and proper Speed; this prompt does not independently ask its use limit or target choice.

questions.question: Without an effect granting a Repeat or another use, may a Spirit pay a Power Card's printed Energy cost twice to use it twice in one turn? If a Slow Power is made Fast, may it be used once in Fast and again in Slow?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Without an effect granting a Repeat or another use, may a Spirit pay a Power Card's printed Energy cost twice to use it twice in one turn? If a Slow Power is made Fast, may it be used once in Fast and again in Slow?
required_facts: No second use is granted by paying the printed Energy cost again.
A Power made Fast has its one use in Fast, not one in Fast plus one in Slow.
Another use requires an explicit permission such as Repeat.

questions.question: For a standard game, how many balanced Island Boards are used and chosen, how are their initial Invaders, Dahan and Blight placed, and how are the Minor/Major decks and shared piece supplies prepared?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: For a standard game, how many balanced Island Boards are used and chosen, how are their initial Invaders, Dahan and Blight placed, and how are the Minor/Major decks and shared piece supplies prepared?
required_facts: Randomly choose one balanced Island Board per Spirit and assemble the island.
Populate all lands using printed Invader, Dahan and Blight setup icons.
Take setup island Blight from the box rather than the pool.
Shuffle Minor and Major decks separately and provide separate shared discard spaces.
Prepare accessible shared supplies of Energy, Invaders and Dahan.

key_context_not_required.fact: Setup Blight does not cascade or destroy Presence.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks island/supply preparation and placement, not an interaction involving setup Blight consequences.

questions.question: Ocean In Play is active on a board. Infinite Vitality with its threshold protects Dahan in that Ocean, and a Power Pushes a Dahan into it. Ocean In Play triggers but cannot destroy that Dahan. With an adjacent non-Ocean land available, what happens next: does the Dahan remain until cleanup, or is it Pushed? Is that relocation an actual Push within the triggered action or merely cleanup?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Ocean In Play is active on a board. Infinite Vitality with its threshold protects Dahan in that Ocean, and a Power Pushes a Dahan into it. Ocean In Play triggers but cannot destroy that Dahan. With an adjacent non-Ocean land available, what happens next: does the Dahan remain until cleanup, or is it Pushed? Is that relocation an actual Push within the triggered action or merely cleanup?
required_facts: Ocean In Play makes an actual Push of the protected surviving Dahan to a non-Ocean land as part of its own triggered action.
It is not waiting for the later non-action cleanup step; cleanup only handles still-illegal pieces after the tree.

key_context_not_required.fact: No expansion effect or piece is needed; FAQ supplies a core case.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: This supports scope validation, not the requested game outcome.

key_context_not_required.fact: This real Push can trigger applicable downstream movement effects.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks whether the relocation itself is a Push within the triggered action rather than later cleanup; it does not ask about any additional triggered effect.

questions.question: A land-targeting Power Card is Repeated using a permission that does not specify where the Repeat occurs. Must it use the original target land? May it instead use another legal land, and do the ordinary Range and Target restrictions still apply?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A land-targeting Power Card is Repeated using a permission that does not specify where the Repeat occurs. Must it use the original target land? May it instead use another legal land, and do the ordinary Range and Target restrictions still apply?
required_facts: An ordinary Repeat need not keep the original land.
Choose the same or another legal land under normal Range and Target restrictions.

key_context_not_required.fact: A Repeat with a specified location uses that location rule instead of the ordinary Range and Target restrictions.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt explicitly supplies an ordinary Repeat with no specified location and asks its retargeting/ordinary-restriction rule. It does not request explaining the other branch.

questions.question: Concealing Shadows has already resolved in Fast, so Dahan in its target land take no Damage from Ravaging Invaders this turn. That land now Ravages with one Town, one Explorer and two healthy Dahan, no Defend and no prior Blight. What happens to land and Dahan, how much counterattack Damage is available, and can it destroy both Invaders for how much Ravage-generated Fear?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Concealing Shadows has already resolved in Fast, so Dahan in its target land take no Damage from Ravaging Invaders this turn. That land now Ravages with one Town, one Explorer and two healthy Dahan, no Defend and no prior Blight. What happens to land and Dahan, how much counterattack Damage is available, and can it destroy both Invaders for how much Ravage-generated Fear?
required_facts: Invaders deal 3 Damage to land, causing one Blight.
Concealing Shadows prevents Dahan Damage only; both Dahan survive healthy.
They counterattack for 4 total Damage.
They can destroy both Town and Explorer with excess unused.
This Ravage generates 1 Fear from the Town.

key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt explicitly asks Ravage-generated Fear; an answer need only give that 1 Fear and need not recount earlier card Fear.
